title: Recipes Registry File (recipes.json)
description: Schema for the recipes registry. Per ADR-0005, recipes are pure-data Registry File entries. The recipes.json file maps recipe ids to recipe definitions. Recipes describe how items (or blocks) transform into other items via crafting stations or player actions.

category.description: Top-level crafting category. Drives UI grouping and skill checks.

inputs.description: Required input items. All consumed when the recipe is crafted.

consumed.description: If false, the item must be present but is not consumed (a catalyst).

outputs.description: Items produced when the recipe is crafted.

probability.description: Probability of producing this output. Defaults to 1 (always). Less than 1 for stochastic outputs like rare byproducts.

station_required.description: Optional. station:* URN. Some recipes are craftable anywhere (knapping a flint); most require a specific station.

tool_required.description: Optional. item:* URN of a tool that must be in inventory (and used) to craft this. Tool durability decrements per craft.

time_to_craft_seconds.description: Real-time seconds of crafting animation. Zero means instant.

tech_tier_required.description: Minimum tech tier the player must have unlocked to craft this. Mirrors the flagship game's analog-tech progression.

magic_tradition_required.description: Optional. Specific magic tradition required (e.g., 'karnish_sky_magic'). For recipes only craftable by NPCs of that tradition, or by the player after learning it.

unlocks_via.description: How the player learns this recipe. 'default' means available from the start; others gate it behind a discovery mechanic.
